newsitem.title: USA: Beauticontrol Q2 affected by Asia Pacific business.
newsitem.headline: Beauticontrol Q2 affected by Asia Pacific business.

text.p: Beauticontrol Cosmetics Inc said Wednesday that costs related to its expansion to the Asia-Pacific region impacted its second quarter 1997 earnings by $0.02 per share.
Jinger Heath, president and chief executive officer, said an additional $0.18 per share will be spent in those operations in the last two fiscal quarters of 1997.
The costs relate to investment in the region, which will be made this year to establish operations, develop products lines and introduce products.
"We expect our Asia-Pacific business to add material sales and profits to the 1998 fiscal year," he said.
The company expects to open its first Pacific Rim subsidiary in January 1998 and has named former U.S. Ambassador to Sweden Gregory Newell as president of Beauticontrol, Asia Pacific.
He said the company spent the past 18 months analyzing global expansion alternatives and is confident it can expand into one or more countries a year over the next five years.
For the quarter ended May 31, it said it posted a net income of $1.06 million, or $0.17 a share, compared with $1.64 million or $0.27 a share for the year-ago quarter.
